suggestions.title: Preload Critical LCP Image
suggestions.description: The LCP element's load time significantly exceeds the optimal threshold. Implement preloading to prioritize its loading.
suggestions.implementation: Use createOptimizedPicture function to set fetchpriority='high' for the image dynamically with JavaScript.

suggestions.title: Optimize Critical JavaScript Execution
suggestions.description: Unused code in critical scripts is delaying interaction readiness and contributing to a high INP.
suggestions.implementation: Use code splitting for auth0-spa-js.production.js and defer non-critical parts post-LCP.

suggestions.title: Defer Non-essential Inline Styles
suggestions.description: styles.css contains styles that can be deferred to reduce render-blocking resources.
